privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: A plain-language summary of how Soundprint-AI handles your data. We built this app for your listening stats — not to sell your information.

sections.title: Who's responsible
paragraphs: Wesley Ajavon (Soundprint-AI) is responsible for your data. Questions? Reach us through account settings or the support channel on the site.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Only what's needed to run your dashboard:
bullets: Account info — email, name, profile photo, and how you sign in.
Listening history — artists, tracks, and when you played them.
Connections — if you link Spotify or similar services.
Your choices — cookie preferences, AI settings, and other consents.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To show your stats, keep you signed in, and improve the app. Optional analytics and error reporting only run if you agree in our cookie settings.
AI features that send artist or track names to a provider only run when you opt in.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Your account and listening data stay while your account is active. If you delete your account, we erase your data promptly from our systems.

sections.title: Who we work with
paragraphs: We rely on trusted providers to run the app. They process data only on our instructions and for the purposes below.
bullets: Supabase (hosting, auth, database, profile photo storage) — runs your account and stores your listening data.
Groq (US) — optional AI features when you opt in; may receive artist/track titles and aggregated listening stats.
Vercel (global) — hosts the app; optional analytics only if you consent to cookies.
Sentry (US/EU) — optional error monitoring and session replay only if you consent to cookies.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Some providers may process data outside your country (including the United States). When required, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the providers' data processing agreements and standard contractual clauses.
Groq and Sentry are only used for the optional features described above and only when you opt in (AI) or accept the relevant cookies.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, export, correct, or delete your data. Go to Settings → Data & privacy to export or delete your account.
You can also change cookie and AI choices anytime. If you're in the EU, you may contact your local data protection authority.

contact.title: Privacy requests
contact.body: For questions about your data or to exercise your rights, email us at:
contact.fallback: For privacy requests, use Settings → Data & privacy (export or delete) or configure a contact address for your deployment.
contact.emailAriaLabel: Send a privacy request email to {email}

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: A quick overview of your rights and ours when you use Soundprint-AI. By using the app, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: What this is
paragraphs: Soundprint-AI is your personal listening dashboard. Import your history or connect services like Spotify to explore your stats.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Keep your login safe. Use accurate info and don't impersonate anyone else.

sections.title: Your music data
paragraphs: Your listening data stays yours. You let us process it only to run the dashboard. Only upload data you own or are allowed to use.

sections.title: Connected services
paragraphs: If you link Spotify, Apple Music, Last.fm, or AI features, their rules apply too. Soundprint-AI isn't affiliated with Apple, Spotify, or Last.fm.

sections.title: A few expectations
paragraphs: We provide the service as-is. Stats depend on what you import, so they may not be perfect.
We're not responsible for outages caused by third-party services.

sections.title: Leaving the service
paragraphs: You can delete your account anytime in Settings.
We may suspend accounts that abuse the service or break the law.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use a few cookies to keep you signed in and remember your choices. Optional ones help us improve the app — only if you say yes.

sections.title: What we use
paragraphs: In plain terms:
bullets: Essential — needed to sign in and use the app.
Preferences — things like your theme or display settings.
Optional analytics — help us see which pages are used.
Optional error reporting — help us fix bugs faster.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: Use the panel below to accept, reject, or customize optional cookies anytime.
Saying no to optional cookies won't stop you from using Soundprint-AI. You can also clear cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage we set
paragraphs: Technical names below help you recognize what the app stores in your browser.
bullets: Supabase auth cookies (sb-*-auth-token) — essential; keep you signed in.
ai_master_disabled — httpOnly; remembers if you turned off AI for this browser.
ama_oauth_terms — short-lived; records that you accepted terms before an OAuth redirect.
ama_anonymous_id — links anonymous cookie choices to your account after sign-in.
localStorage ama-cookie-consent-v1 — your cookie banner choices on this device.
localStorage ama_anonymous_id — anonymous id used before you create an account.
Theme preference — stored locally for light/dark mode (not sent to our servers).

preferences.title: Manage your preferences
preferences.description: Pick what you're comfortable with. Changes apply right away on this browser.
